annotation_method: Manual visual review of all 12 page renders at 120 DPI; no LLM judge and no router predictions were inspected before labels were frozen.
label_definition: Route only pages containing a vector ruled/grid table that the local geometry reconstruction can use. Raster tables, charts, diagrams, prose, covers, and contents pages stay on the PyMuPDF fallback.
